name: io.github.quarto-dev/hub-mcp
title: Quarto Hub
description: Read, write, search, and watch files in Quarto Hub projects over automerge sync.

environmentVariables.name: QUARTO_HUB_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Automerge sync server URL. Defaults to wss://quarto-hub.com/ws.

environmentVariables.name: QUARTO_HUB_MCP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client id for hubs that require sign-in. Unset: the server runs unauthenticated (sufficient for no-auth hubs).

environmentVariables.name: QUARTO_HUB_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret paired with QUARTO_HUB_MCP_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: QUARTO_HUB_MCP_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: OIDC issuer override (default: Google). Must be an https:// URL.
